findings.duodenum: Severe villous atrophy, scalloping of folds
findings.biopsy: Marsh Grade 3c - Total villous atrophy consistent with Celiac Disease

reports.doctorNotes: Endoscopy confirms Celiac Disease with severe villous atrophy (Marsh 3c). Biopsy shows complete loss of villi in duodenum. Patient MUST maintain strict gluten-free diet for life. Even trace amounts of gluten (wheat, barley, rye, contaminated oats) will trigger autoimmune response and intestinal damage. Avoid: bread, pasta, chapati, biscuits, cakes, beer, soy sauce (unless labeled gluten-free). Safe alternatives: rice, quinoa, millets, corn, potatoes. Prescribed vitamin B12 and calcium supplements due to malabsorption. Follow-up endoscopy in 1 year to assess healing.

reports.doctorNotes: IgE testing confirms EXTREME hypersensitivity to peanuts (Class 6, 125 kU/L) and severe allergies to all tree nuts. Family members trained on EpiPen administration.
